page: Vultr vx1-m-96c-768g-5760s is a memory-optimized server instance within the VX1 Cloud Compute family. It features 96 dedicated AMD x86_64 vCPUs paired with 768.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per core. This dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent compute performance without resource contention.

The instance includes 5760 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, providing high-capacity, low-latency data access for large datasets. It is provisioned with one complimentary public IPv4 address. No graphics processing units are included in this configuration, making it a CPU- and memory-focused resource.

Given the high memory-to-vCPU ratio and substantial local NVMe storage, this instance offers high resource density for enterprise workloads. It is designed for memory-intensive applications, large-scale databases, data warehousing, and high-throughput transaction processing systems that require substantial local storage and dedicated CPU resources.

With its dedicated CPU allocation and high memory-to-core ratio, this instance is designed for demanding workloads such as large-scale relational databases, in-memory data stores, data warehousing, and intensive enterprise applications requiring substantial local storage capacity and consistent compute performance.
